notes: The supplied subject the brethren is folded onto ἔταξαν under rule 103's licensing test — the finite verb's English is incomplete without a subject, as LUK.8.49 folds house; reading it added remains defensible and is recorded in the unit's note.
The English reorders the datives τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρναβᾷ into subjects, but each token keeps its own word under rule 2 and each article is unrepresented under rule 23.
τοῦ before ζητήματος τούτου is unrepresented under rule 38, the demonstrative occupying the determiner slot.
